## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the path, key, or URI of a storage location within its service.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the geographic device site ([`gmeow:physicalPlace`](gmeow-physicalPlace.md)) and for the service name ([`gmeow:storageService`](gmeow-storageService.md)).

### How to use

- Add [`gmeow:storagePath`](gmeow-storagePath.md) alongside [`gmeow:storageService`](gmeow-storageService.md) and the functional [`gmeow:storageMedium`](gmeow-storageMedium.md).
